paragraphs: A feeding pillow is a support device that had to be made to look like soft furnishing. The shape is determined entirely by where a baby has to sit relative to a seated adult, and everything else about it is an argument about washability.
The model is extremely light at 4,130 polygons and 4,156 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits product and retail visualisation, e-commerce and catalogue imagery, advertising, nursery and interior scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A monument in pieces is a genre of its own. The severed head of a familiar statue is shorthand for collapse in film and illustration alike, and it works because the viewer has to have known the intact version for the ruin to mean anything.
The model holds 30,846 polygons and 31,545 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification.
At $29 it suits film and television production, game environments, post apocalyptic and concept art, editorial and conceptual illustration, and advertising. On sale since 2024.

The sensor is the only part of a camera that cannot be improved after the fact. Everything downstream is software, and the silicon under the glass sets the ceiling on what any amount of processing will ever be able to recover.
The model is supplied in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits technology and component visualisation, technical documentation, e-commerce imagery, exploded views, education material and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The capsule made coffee a subscription. What the holder is really doing is displaying a commitment: a rack of colour coded pods on a counter is an ongoing relationship with one machine and one supplier.
The model is light at 52,400 polygons and 27,253 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplying the holder together with the capsules, and carries StemCell certification.

The carrick bend joins two heavy ropes and, unusually, can still be untied after being loaded hard. That is why it was the traditional choice for towing hawsers, where the alternative was cutting the rope to free it.

The model is extremely light at 1,344 polygons and 1,404 vertices, built at subdivision level with non-overlapping UVs, so it smooths cleanly at any scale. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits marine and outdoor education, technical illustration, equipment marketing, instructional material, game props and editorial work. On sale since 2021.

Four fingers and white gloves is a convention that came from early animation and stuck for practical reasons. Fewer digits are easier to draw consistently, and the gloves separate the hands from the body when both are the same colour.
The model is extremely light at 3,264 polygons and 1,636 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits animation and motion graphics, children's media, game characters, advertising and mascot work, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

The flute exists to keep bubbles. A narrow bowl gives the gas less surface to escape from, which is the entire argument, and the recent fashion for wider glasses is a bet that aroma matters more than the stream of bubbles rising.
The model is extremely light at 5,528 polygons and 5,580 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 3 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits tableware and hospitality visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, event and interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

A perfume bottle is a sculpture with a licence to be impractical. It will sit on a dressing table far longer than it takes to empty, and the glass is engineered to be photographed rather than to be poured.

The model is extremely light at 4,353 polygons and 4,386 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 10 maps, 5 at 4096x4096 and 5 at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits product and packaging visualisation, e-commerce and catalogue imagery, advertising, bathroom and interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2018.

The Churchill is a size rather than a brand, and it is a long one. The format exists because a larger ring gauge burns cooler, which matters over the length of time a cigar that size is intended to last.
The model is extremely light at 974 polygons and 1,011 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $29 it suits product and packaging visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, period and interior scenes, film props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The pedestal exists to hide the plumbing and nothing else. It carries almost no weight, the basin is bolted to the wall, and the column underneath is a decorative screen that has outlived every attempt to replace it.

The model is very light at 7,293 polygons and 7,750 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with one map at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a black build is offered separately.

The height of an umpire's chair is not about visibility, it is about the net. The official has to see both sides of a line that a player standing on the ground cannot judge, and the seat is set at exactly the height that makes that possible.

The model is very light at 7,152 polygons and 7,540 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 8 maps, 4 at 4096x4096 and 4 at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a green build is offered separately.
At $29 it suits sports facility visualisation, court and stadium scenes, equipment marketing, broadcast graphics, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2016.

A butcher's counter is refrigeration disguised as furniture. The glass angle, the lighting temperature and the depth of the tray are all chosen to make the product look right, and the customer never sees the machinery keeping it cold.
The model holds 55,321 polygons and 56,246 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 11 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.

The V arrangement on a compressor pump is about cooling as much as balance. Splayed cylinders get more air over the fins, and a compressor that runs continuously fails on heat long before it fails on anything mechanical.
The model holds 71,547 polygons and 71,577 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in yellow. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.

Transparent packaging in this category is a deliberate public health decision. Making the product visible rather than hidden was fought for over decades, and the shift from plain wrappers to clear ones is part of that argument.
The model holds 79,868 polygons and 39,972 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
